defence.line: The blood of God is my defence
stanza: The blood of God is my defence
Let it drip down to my seed
Showers to your innocence
To protect you for all eternity
And with this wood I beat this drum
And we won't see defeat
From kings and queens becomes a prince
Knowledge and wisdom is understanding what we need

defense.line: When I already shed my best defense
defense.linePrev: Trying to crawl under my skin
defense.lineNext: It comes out all around that you won

fence.line: Older gents sit on the fence
stanza: Older gents sit on the fence
With their cap in hand
Looking grand
They watch their city change

fence.line: All she want is her picket fence
fence.linePrev: Now your baby mama ain't so vicious
fence.lineNext: And you protest, and you picket sign

incense.line: May God bless you with incense
stanza: So fight on as you are
My American princess
May God bless you with incense
You’re my shining American star
And it doesn't make sense
I should fall for the kingcraft of a meritless crown
It doesn't seem right
To take information given at close range
For the gag and the bind and the ammunition round

sense.line: She's working hard to make some sense
stanza: I don't know if it's the wine or the coke
That makes her sound like her jaw is broke
She's working hard to make some sense
But she ain't got a dime
I wish to God that I could help her out
I wish she knew what she was talkin' 'bout
I wish to God that I could get away
But I'm way too drunk to drive

sense.line: Desperado, why don't you come to your senses?
stanza: Desperado, why don't you come to your senses?
You've been out ridin' fences for so long now
Oh, you're a hard one, but I know that you got your reasons
These things that are pleasin' you can hurt you somehow

sense.line: I have my senses and my sense of having senses
stanza: So when I say that I know me, how can I know that?
What kind of spider understands arachnophobia?
I have my senses and my sense of having senses
Do I guide them? Or they me?

sense.line: Who made no goddamn common sense
stanza: I get a little punchy with the vodka
Just like my great uncle Valentine Jester did
When he had to deal with those people like you
Who made no goddamn common sense
I'd rather walk all the way home right now
Than to spend one more second in this place
I'm exactly like you, Valentine, just
Come outside and leave with me
It gets you down, it gets you down
There's no spark, no light in the dark
It gets you down, it gets you down
You traveled far, what have you found?
That there's no time, there's no time
To analyse, to think things through
To make sense
